info.name: Palisade Addresses Balances and statements API

items.docs: Get balances for local and remote accounts owned by a RippleNet address.
Get balances for ledger owned by a RippleNet address.

params.name: account_name_with_address
params.description: The RippleNet account name and address that you want to return a statement for. Use the format `accountname@ripplenetaddress`. For example, `san_francisco@rn.us.ca.san_francisco`.

params.name: start-date
params.description: The lower bound of the date-time range you want to return statement information for, as an ISO-8601 timestamp in UTC. For example, `2018-08-06T23:13:55.997Z`.

params.name: end-date
params.description: The upper bound of the date-time range you want to return statement information for, as an ISO-8601 timestamp in UTC For example, `2018-08-06T23:15:13.218Z`.

params.name: page
params.description:
The page number for [paginated results](/products/payments-odl/api-docs/ripplenet/best-practices/pagination/). The value is zero-based, where `0` represents the first page.
Set it to `0` to get the first page of results.

params.name: size
params.description:
Number of payment and transfer objects to return per page, with a limit of 100 per page.

For example, a query with `"size": "100"` results in `"totalPages": "43"` when the query result is `"totalElements": "4290"`.

items.docs: Gets a statement for an account that lists payments and transfers that impacted the account's balance during a specified date-time range.
